lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Commander!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Hey, Junior Blockhead.
Yes?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You like cafes, don't you?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: No, that's not it, right?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: You like the Maid Cafe better, don't you, Commander?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Silence.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Now, just tell me the Armory's the best.
Why?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Don't ask why.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Just answer like that.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hey, Eunhwa, that's so unfair!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: How can you do that? T_T

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, this might be sudden, but can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Commander, where do you like to go the most?
Cafes.
The Maid Cafe.
The Armory.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh my, hehe. I knew you'd say that.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: That's so you, Commander! ^^

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: :S
Why are you asking me this all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Well, actually...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: We were talking about what would be fun to do during the next break,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: but everyone wanted to go different places and do different things.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So we decided to ask you,

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: and we'll go wherever you say you like best, hehe.
I see. Well, a cafe is a safe, solid choice, isn't it?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yeah, but...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Emma said she'd be making the desserts herself at the cafe... T_T

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: And the drinks too :/

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: It's been a while, but I finally got a chance to cook for everyone again!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I can't tell you how happy that makes me, hehe! ^^

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: If you're free, Commander, would you like to come too?
Sorry, but I'm busy.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Come.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You started this, so take responsibility and eat it all before you leave.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yeah!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I think you should definitely come too, Commander.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, so you'll be coming too, Commander?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'll let you know the exact time once we've decided.
No, I said I'm busy...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yay!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hehe, I'm so happy!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: I knew it! I just knew you'd say the Maid Cafe, Commander.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Tsk. =.=

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Aww, that's too bad, hehe.
Why are you asking me this all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Uh, well...

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: We were talking about where to go for our upcoming break,

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: but everyone wanted to go somewhere different.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: to be fair, we decided we'd go wherever you chose, Commander!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: And you just so happened to pick the place I wanted to go!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Why the hell do we have to go somewhere like that on our day off?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I just don't get it at all.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It's a ton of fun there! Really!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: The maids wear these super cute outfits,

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: and they make all these pretty, delicious desserts just for you!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Ooooh, that sounds like fun!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Anyway! We agreed to go wherever the Commander chose,

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: so no changing your minds now, okay?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You're utterly useless,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Junior Blockhead. =.=

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Eunhwa, hehe, you're not thinking of running away, are you?
Eunhwa doesn't respond.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: :S

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: She won't even answer my calls. T_T

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Oh dear, I'd better go look for her right away!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Thank you, Commander! See you around!
Wait... did you really contact me just for that?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: For once,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: you actually gave a decent answer.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You've grown. Well done.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Aww, that's too bad, hehe.
Can I ask my question now?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Go ahead.
Why are you asking me this all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We were discussing where to go for our day off,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: but Emma and Vesti came up with some really pointless places.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: It's not pointless at all!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: So I figured we'd ask you,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: then go wherever you said.
You're not seriously going to spend your day off at the Armory, are you?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Yes, we are.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Weapon maintenance must never be neglected, even during downtime.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Moreover, when it comes to building camaraderie,

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: drafting strategies that can help with operations

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: is very helpful.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: You call that a day off?!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: That just sounds like more work to me. T_T

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I also think that it's really important to take proper breaks, hehe.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: This too counts as rest.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: No, it doesn't! :(

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What's with all the bellyaching?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Didn't we agree to go with Junior Blockhead's answer?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: You cheated, Eunhwa.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: So of course it's kinda hard for us to just accept it, hehe.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Yeah, that's right!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: You told the Commander to say the Armory's the best!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: That's cheating! So it doesn't count!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Trying to weasel your way out already, huh?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Regardless of the method, a win's a win.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: And this time, I won.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: We gotta talk this out in person, Eunhwa!

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: I'm heading over as well. ^^
Hey... guys?
Can you calm down for a sec and listen to me?
Honestly, I actually like the Maid Cafe better.
However, no one answers.
